name: Lacunex
manufacturer: Novafold Pharmaceuticals (official product: treatment-resistant PTSD protocol, heavily diverted)
description: Originally developed as a therapeutic intervention for trauma processing, Lacunex selectively disrupts hippocampal memory consolidation for a configurable retrograde window of 1-72 hours, erasing episodic memory while leaving procedural memory and identity intact. The dose-window relationship is reliable enough that operators use it surgically — a 6-hour dose wipes a meeting, a 48-hour dose wipes a job. Novafold officially sells it under a compassionate-use prescription framework; 80% of street supply is diverted clinical stock.
effects: configurable retrograde episodic memory erasure (1-72 hour window)
subject retains full function post-dose with no awareness of the gap
BCI memory logs within the erasure window are simultaneously corrupted if subject's BCI lacks hardened storage
side_effects: irregular erasure edges — subjects sometimes retain emotional residue of erased events without knowing why (unexplained dread, grief, or rage)
repeated use causes cumulative hippocampal degradation — eventual permanent short-term memory impairment
subjects with SNT-enhanced hippocampal augments are partially resistant — may retain fragments
rare paradox effect: some subjects form a 'phantom memory' — false constructed narrative to fill the gap that feels real and cannot be distinguished from genuine recall
duration: Erasure is permanent for the target window; drug itself clears in 6 hours
street_price: Φ 600–1,800 per dose (street); Φ 3,200 with prescription
cultural_context: The operational cleaner. Used by fixers to process witnesses, by corpos to manage employees who've seen too much, and occasionally by individuals who simply cannot live with something they've done. The therapeutic framing Novafold maintains is not entirely false — there is a genuine PTSD market. But the street application has made 'getting Blanked' a common enough phrase in GLMZ that most people understand what it means without explanation.
story_hooks: A witness to a Tier 4 corporate assassination wakes with 36 hours missing and an inexplicable terror response every time they smell a specific cologne. The phantom memory is trying to surface.
A fixer discovers their handler has been dosing them with Lacunex after every job — they have no memory of their last four contracts, and no idea what they've done.
Novafold's clinical supply chain is hit by a diversion ring operating from inside the company. A Tier 3 investigator follows the trail upward and finds it ends at a Spire address.
